messages.subject: Error when using a custom to_predict
messages.subject_clean: Error when using a custom to_predict
messages.body_plain:
I've fitted a model using glmer() from the lme4 package, and have attempted to use the following code to generate predictions on a data frame I want to generate predictions for.

I used the following code: ezPredict(fit=full.model,to_predict=pred)

Which generates the following error: Error in match(x, table, nomatch = 0L) : object 'data_vars' not found

Any idea what's causing this? The patch notes for 4.0 seem to suggest this is a bug that's fixed.

messages.body_plain:
Can't provide the data itself, but this is the code I used to create the model:

full.model <- glmer(X ~ A + t_before + t_after + B + C + (t_before+t_after+A+B|group) + offset(log(people)), data=full, family="poisson")

I then made a prediction data set with values for t_before, t_after, A, B and C in Excel, imported it as a data frame:

pred <- as.data.frame(read.csv("~/predict.csv"))
ezPredict(fit=full.model,to_predict=pred)

Which generated the mentioned error.

messages.body_plain:
Hm, I'm still not sure what's going awry. Your predict.csv data has
column names that match those used to fit the model, right? Including
"people"?

Also, try removing the  "+offset(log(people))" part of the model,
refit, and let me know if you get the same error when you try to use
ezPredict (this time using a data frame supplied to "to_predict" that
does *not* have a "people" column).

Mike
